base_model.alignment: state-local zero-based indexes into the exact base-model arrays

crossing.browser_use: scenario crossing-probability display only; do not use delta_pp as an official payment-error dollar-rate anchor shift
crossing.definition: p_dev times conditional P(abs(D) strictly above threshold) from the quantile interpolation and q99 log-tail
crossing.state_factor_reason: the frozen factor scales expected error dollars, not case crossing probabilities

interpretation.statement: Deltas are model-implied associations from burden features that add only +0.006 ROC AUC; they are not causal policy effects.

level_ratio_gate.disabled_reason: Factor-adjusted FY2024 model-to-observed dollar-rate ratio is outside the inclusive [0.7, 1.4] validation range.
level_ratio_gate.ratio: factor-adjusted analytic model / observed FY2024 sample

bbce_resources.label: Broad-based categorical eligibility resources
bbce_resources.reason: the fitted model has no asset-verification intermediate

heat_and_eat.label: Heat-and-eat
heat_and_eat.reason: utility_actuals records observed SUA treatment and cannot identify which cases adoption or repeal would move

smd.label: Standard medical deduction
smd.limitation: proxy omits the state standard amount, whether it binds, and documentation of actual expenses above the standard

ssed.label: Standard self-employment deduction
ssed.reason: se_records counts people with positive net self-employment income; it is not an expense-documentation requirement

per_case_encoding.i: zero-based index into the state's model_data arrays
per_case_encoding.patch_endpoint: policy endpoint produced by applying replacements to model_data
per_case_encoding.q: full flipped nine-quantile natural-log-dollar vector, using base-model quantization

uncertainty.method: paired nonparametric iid bootstrap of FY2024 QC cases; sample rows with replacement, retain encoded HWGT inside each weighted mean, and use percentile intervals

co_smd.interpretation: The estimates need not be equal because the shipped scenario uses a different frozen distributional estimand. Reconciliation requires the same documented predicate and flip count, adoption-normalized direction, concordant point signs, and overlapping conditional uncertainty. The reference artifact does not expose case IDs, so exact mask membership cannot be independently verified.
co_smd.reference_models: through-FY2023 primary direct classifier and calibrated hurdle
co_smd.reference_reason: ceiling changes the same documentation predicate for 53 cases and has zero engine benefit/deduction/net-income changes
